name: DJ Ray
reviewNotes:
No website or socials found; do not confuse with line-dance instructor Ray Swartz (Line Dance With Ray) without confirmation.

Directory research 2026-10-04 (identity not confirmed; nothing applied): The act itself is real: the Massapequa Elks Lodge runs repeat 'Sounds of DJ Ray' oldies dances (find.dance, The Dance Calendar). But I could not tie it to any official website or social page, so no links recorded. Candidates for the owner to check: (1) DJ Ray Entertainment / Precious Moments DJs, https://djrayentertainmentnyc.com/ (tri-state wedding/party DJ, 30 years, music from the 1920s to today; no Long Island or Elks mention); (2) 'Sounds of DJ Ray Incorporated', a New York business corporation registered in Westbury, NY (Bizapedia) - its name matches the Elks event title 'Sounds of DJ Ray', but no website or social page found for it. Still do not confuse with line-dance teacher Ray Swartz. Current genres (oldies, 70s-80s, swing, Motown, hustle, freestyle) come from the listings and look right for an Elks oldies dance; kept as is.
